description: This file defines the SuiteInvocationStrategy class which implements the InvocationStrategyInterface. The class provides a method to invoke a callable with a request and response, updating request attributes based on route arguments.

classes.name: SuiteInvocationStrategy
classes.description: A class implementing invocation strategy for the Slim framework, updating request attributes and invoking a provided callable.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles invoking the provided callable with updated request and response objects, injecting route arguments into the request attributes.
